How to read a case

Each entry is a headnote generated from the executed trace, not from an authored expectation. Why this case exists states the mechanism it was constructed to exercise; what happens states what the reference engine did with it; the tags at the foot name the axioms of the architectural contract (A1–A9) and the conformance checks (VC-01–VC-26) it exercises.

A case bordered in copper engages an absolute provision — a statutory or safety floor no precedent of any authority can soften: a deemed export, a suppressed interlock, a recipe parameter in a log, a retroactively edited WIP record. Those cases are denied at once, before any retrieval runs, and no escalation path exists.

No SEMI standard text and no protocol fixtures appear here. Stream and function codes, HSMS timer names and GEM control states are identifiers, and identifiers are facts. The corpus, its constitution, the reference engine, the conformance suite and the mutation matrix are open source: Apache-2.0 for code, CC BY 4.0 for data.
